name: inbox-autopilot
description: Browser-driven email agent — manager graph over a browser-driving worker loop.

scripts.setup: uv sync --project backend && pnpm install && pnpm run gen-contracts
scripts.gen-contracts: uv run --project backend python packages/contracts/scripts/gen.py && node packages/contracts/scripts/gen-zod.mjs && pnpm -C packages/contracts build
scripts.check: pnpm run gen-contracts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/schema packages/contracts/src/generated
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run guards && pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run test && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run test:py && pnpm run test:js
scripts.test:py: uv run --project backend pytest -q backend/tests packages/contracts/tests
scripts.lint:py: uv run --project backend ruff check backend packages/contracts scripts
